finding: Screen sparked after charging a Series 4 A1977. Apple’s screen replacement program covered Series 2 and 3 for edge cracking. No Series 4 action found.
GPW2300 washer base expelled metal and hose. Prior US/Canada Greenworks recall covered plastic spray guns on different lower-pressure models.
Onewheel+ threw the rider. The US recall already listed every original Onewheel+ in September 2023.
Explosion and fire in an eRqILUJI/ZDEH light-socket adapter. Searched the brand, importer and ASIN B0C8DBM1VC across the ledger and public US, Canadian and UK warnings. No matching action found.
Several Great Value GVL4T812 tubes burned. In 2021 Intertek warned about the same certification mark 5005914 on a different Great Value model, GVL2T81250. No covered CPSC action found.
Bosch SHV78CM3N/28 dishwasher door slammed shut, injuring household members. Prior BSH recalls concern older product cohorts and power cords. No matching door action found.
FD401 LP3 8-quart Foodi bowl shed a metal strip. The earlier US/Canadian pressure-lid recall is for the OP300 series and a different failure.
Samsung RF30KMEDBSR/AA fridge repeatedly froze its ice maker and failed to cool. The narrative records warranty repairs and a refund. No covering CPSC or Canadian action found.
Bissell 28062 carpet cleaner melted. US/Canadian notices concerned other products, including a steam-cleaner attachment. No matching model or carpet-cleaner action found.
LG LREL6323S oven shed coating during self-cleaning. The later US/Canada accidental knob activation action covers a different model list and failure.
The 2026 CPSC pressure and scald warning names Balbali travel kettles. No notice found for Fellow Stagg EKG EE01AA1A.
The 2019 UK Whirlpool fire recall covered older Hotpoint tumble dryers. No notice found for the reported GE/Hotpoint HYX26EASW0WW purchased in 2025.
MECO’s 1995 fix addressed coals falling through three charcoal smoker models. The Walk-A-Bout report describes peeling underside coating.
Samsung recalled NE63T8511SS/AA for accidental knob activation in August 2024. The August 2025 incident followed installation of the recall remedy.
Viking recalled 36-inch built-in refrigerators for detaching doors. No notice found for the JennAir JF42NXFXDE02 or its JBFFS42NHL freezer panel.
The recalled Relay USB-A cable that could overheat had a five-pin charging head. The Courant cable failed at its USB-C connector.
The US and Canadian Bambu A1 recalls addressed the heatbed cable. No notice found for the QIDI Q1 Pro extruder that overheated.
The US and Canadian ASKO dishwasher recalls addressed overheating power cords. No recall found for LG LDFN3432T, whose report does not identify the ignition source.
The US and Canadian Whirlpool recalls covered touch-control glass cooktops that switched on spontaneously. WFC150M0EW0 is a freestanding range with reported heat from the oven vent.
CPSC 24-117 lists other FCRE306 electric models. The later March 2026 recall lists gas FCRG306LAF and starts at VF52200000, above the reported VF51876852.
